svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of a cylinder rolling up and down an incline
svg.desc: Three stacked graphs for a cylinder pushed up an incline with v0 = +2.0 m/s and a constant acceleration of −1.0 m/s², with +x up the slope. Position is a downward-opening parabola that peaks at 2.0 m at 2.0 s and returns to 0 at 4.0 s. Velocity is a straight line falling from +2.0 m/s through zero at 2.0 s to −2.0 m/s at 4.0 s. Acceleration is a horizontal line at −1.0 m/s².
